name: 43110 · Canal Wnchstr, OH
findings: ZIP 43110 (Canal Wnchstr) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43110 (Canal Wnchstr) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
